description: This source file contains internal helper functions related to Android device diagnostics within the OpenClaw app, including version labeling, gateway status evaluation, diagnostics report generation, and clipboard copy functionality.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns a version label string for the Android app, appending '-dev' if in debug mode and version name is not empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a sanitized, displayable version of the gateway status, defaulting to 'Offline' if input is empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Determines if the gateway status indicates an online or diagnostic state (not offline or connecting).

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Checks if the gateway status suggests a pairing or approval process.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Creates a detailed diagnostic report string with device info, app version, gateway address, status, and instructions.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the generated diagnostics report to clipboard and shows a toast notification.
